0.original: Kageel Ja is in need of seasonings.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested materials to Kageel Ja.

48.original: Mamook's traditional dishes tend to be sparse when it comes to seasonings. Aside from the salt taken from Bitterbark Cenote, the sweet flavoring provided by najool, and a fermented fish sauce, there isn't much else we add to our food.

49.original: So for those who have gone on to experience Tuliyollal's varied cuisine, our local fare is decidedly lacking in comparison.

50.original: On a related note, I've heard a Xbr'aal visitor mentioning certain ingredients found in the upper forest that might improve the taste of our vegetable soup...

51.original: The seasoning you acquired for us the last time has been praised by both the local Mamool Ja and our visiting Xbr'aal friends.

52.original: It's been so popular, in fact, that our stores are running dangerously low...

53.original: Would you be so kind as to bring back some of the rock salt found near Iq Br'aax? It's said to have a smoother flavor than the stuff we extract from Bitterbark.

54.original: Would you be so kind as to harvest some of the white pepper found near Iq Br'aax? It's said to have a spicy kick that enhances the flavor of the vegetables.

55.original: Would you be so kind as to pull up some algae from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly? It should go well with the soup once dried and ground into a powder.

56.original: Bait your hook with a golden stonefly nymph─an interested fish will drag the algae along for you to pluck free from the water.

57.original: The rock salt in question should be found in the vicinity of Iq Br'aax.

58.original: The white pepper in question should be found in the vicinity of Iq Br'aax.

59.original: You should be able to pull up the algae I spoke of from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly.

60.original: Attract the fish with golden stonefly nymphs and they'll bring the algae to you.

61.original: How went your hunt for seasonings?

62.original: Yes, this will do nicely. My thanks for braving the beasts of the Ut'ohmu Horizon.

63.original: Right, I say we get this ingredient prepared and popped into a soup straightaway. Hopefully our Mamook customers find the taste to their liking.

64.original: Glad I am that our choice of ingredient found favor with the customers. Our cooks, too, seem thrilled to have a new flavor to experiment with.

65.original: As it so happens, this flavor also complements tiika selvaas. Serving it with a side of tasty soup has only made our new dish all the more popular.

66.original: You know, if this can persuade even the studious Anggir to finish a meal over returning to her research, then I think we're onto a winner.
